paper: SIDA: Social Media Image Deepfake Detection, Localization and Explanation with Large Multimodal Model
catalog_ids: N8505; N1939 (same CVPR 2025 work/version cluster; reuse, do not double-count)
screen_decision: High-relevance direct-task neighbor; partial human validation of reference descriptions, not an end-to-end explanation-reliability test
fulltext_methods: CVPR 2025 paper and arXiv v3 full text read. SIDA detects real/synthetic/tampered images, predicts masks, and generates textual explanations. Five experts reviewed 3,000 GPT-4 textual descriptions against the images for semantic accuracy, clarity, and consistency; the descriptions are curated benchmark/training targets. The paper reports detector/localization metrics and qualitative outputs.
reliability_evidence_boundary: The expert check supports quality control of reference descriptions, but the paper does not report a blinded independent evaluation of SIDA's generated explanations against forensic ground truth, inter-rater agreement, causal faithfulness/deletion-insertion or sanity checks, nor user reliance/decision benefit. Do not convert annotation review or mask performance into a claim that the final explanations are reliable.
screening_scope: Official CVF proceedings record and freely available full paper checked. This is a construct-level review, not a field-wide completeness claim.

paper: LEGION: Learning to Ground and Explain for Synthetic Image Detection
screen_decision: High-relevance direct-task neighbor; grounded text/mask evaluation, but no human validation of model explanations
fulltext_methods: ICCV 2025 paper and arXiv full text read. SynthScars contains 12,236 synthetic images with expert-annotated masks, artifact types, and explanations. Twelve trained annotators contributed to dataset annotation and multi-round quality checks. LEGION's explanation text is scored against reference text with ROUGE-L and embedding cosine similarity; masks use mIoU/F1. Human Preference Score evaluates the realism of images refined using LEGION, not explanation validity.
reliability_evidence_boundary: No human ratings of LEGION's generated explanation correctness/helpfulness, no independent claim-level evidence verification, causal faithfulness intervention, explainer sanity check, or appropriate-reliance experiment was identified. ROUGE/CSS may reward lexical/semantic overlap without establishing that cited visual evidence caused the detector verdict. HPS concerns generated-image preference and is out of construct.
screening_scope: Official CVF proceedings record and freely available full paper checked. This is a construct-level review, not a field-wide completeness claim.
